pattern_note: modern boxy polymer .45 blowback SMG with a side-folding stock (UMP family); study-internal only, never in shipped names or text

scale.axes: X = mm forward of the butt face along the bore; Z = mm above (+) / below (-) the bore axis; Y = 0 on the bore plane, +Y = the gun's left (line frame: -Y = right). The spec converts to the Grip-origin frame.
scale.ruler_note: the sheet ruler reads 86.6 cm (+26 %); ignored
scale.accuracy: craft-level readings, about +/-3.5 mm (3 px); the measurer's trace replaces them

height_sight_to_mag_mm.note: +3.7 %; rail-clamp sights stand taller than the real fixed sights

barrel_breech_X.note: a 200 mm barrel from the muzzle puts the breech inside the port span X 453-515, as on the real blowback

panels.LEFT: top-left, true left (knob side), muzzle to screen left
panels.RIGHT: top-right, true right (port side), muzzle to screen right
panels.TOP: bottom-left, screen-down = the gun's left (knob protrudes there)
panels.Q34: bottom-right, 3/4 front view of the left side

real_figures_manual.source: UMP45/UMP40 operator's manual 10/1999 rev 08/2000 (specs table p.47)

stations.note: ball ~18 mm, protrudes ~19 mm; lever bar to X ~505
lower locking pin head on the left face (X ~282, Z ~-18)

parts.name: upper_receiver
parts.construction: Fibre-reinforced polymer box shell, flat vertical sides, flat top at Z +33 under the rail; forearm front face at X 620 (1-2 deg draft, R 2 edge); full-length 0.5-0.8 mm moulded shoulder step at Z ~+12..+15 on both sides; wall 3.0-3.5 mm with real wall reveals at every opening; inside: two steel L-section bolt guide rails (3x4 mm) over the bolt travel +10 mm, the charging-slide guide above the barrel, barrel seat boss with a transverse roll-pin bore, support-bolt bosses at the magwell front, right-rear hinge knuckles (2).
key_features: width = TOP trace (~62-64 mm)
parting witness along the side-wall edge rounds (texture only, 0.05-0.1 mm)
ejector circles 4-6 mm only on hidden faces
no sink drawn = none built
fastener count/position from the trace only
parts.wear: whitening on the vertical corners, front-face rim and forearm lower edge; support-hand polish on the forearm belly and left side; fine fore-aft scratches
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.11 (fibre-reinforced plastic upper, metal guideways, support bolts, cocking lever above the barrel, port with integral catch, left sling eyebolts, hinge at the rear); HKUMP45 photo

parts.name: forearm_vents
parts.construction: Two oblong through-vents per side (~27 x 8.7 mm, Z -3..-11) plus one long upper through-vent per side (left X 561-602, right X 531-598, Z +21.8..+29.5), stadium ends, 1 deg drafted walls, 0.4 mm outer break; the barrel shows through.
key_features: lower vents X 579-606 and 541-570
the real pattern's side-rail hard-point bosses are NOT drawn and NOT built
parts.wear: whitening on vent lips; grime at the vent ends
parts.real_pattern_evidence: HKUMP45 photo + manual img30 (the two lower vents match the real pattern)

parts.name: charging_handle
parts.construction: Non-reciprocating cocking lever: the sheet's ball knob (~18 mm) on a dia 8 neck at X ~551, Z +19.5, protruding ~19 mm; the drawn bar behind it (to X ~505, pin head at its rear) is the lever arm lying flush in a 0.8 mm recess; a 6.5 mm tall channel through the left wall runs REARWARD from the neck for 75 mm + neck (to X ~468) and ends in an upward lock indent (~8 mm rise, ~7 mm wide, round bottom); inside, a steel slide (12x10 mm) in a moulded guide over the barrel with a hook that pushes the bolt's charging lug.
key_features: travel 75 mm (photo-measured, +/-5)
lock rotation about X 0..+18 deg at full travel
returns forward on its own spring
sliding clearance 0.15-0.40 mm
parts.wear: polished knob crown, bright rim; polished channel lips along the travel
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.4/11/20 (pull back, rotate up into the indent; 'slap' to release), parts 12-15; HKUMP45 photo (lever at the FRONT of an ~85 mm slot)

parts.name: lower_receiver
parts.construction: One moulding: trigger housing, integral magwell, integral trigger guard, integral pistol grip, integrated backplate (the tall end block X 278-302 up to the receiver top); front lugs hook onto the upper's support bolts, rear held by the removable locking pin (head dia 7 on the left face of the end block). Design seam 0.3-0.5 mm (0.6 deep) along the drawn upper/lower line and at the end block's front edge.
key_features: magwell X 452-512 down to Z -79 with the flared lip band
guard bottom Z -100
grip bottom Z -167.5, rake 22 deg
selector seat bosses both sides
parts.wear: grip straps and web polished; magwell flare polished + insertion scratch fan; guard bottom whitened
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.14-15 fig 10 (lower receiver with trigger mechanism, backplate, magwell, release, bolt catch; parts list 33-58)

parts.name: magwell
parts.construction: Box around the magazine; mouth flared 1.5-2.0 mm per side over the lowest 8-10 mm with an R 1.5 rolled lip; inner walls 1 deg draft opening downward, 0.3 mm per side to the magazine; catch window in the rear wall for the paddle nose; hard top shelf (feed-ramp ledge) 1-2 mm above the seated magazine; NO guide ribs.
key_features: diagonal sloped front panel from (530,-3) to (512,-42) then a horizontal shelf
dark interior, class E texels (visible with the mag out)
parts.wear: insertion scratch fan into the mouth; lip whitening
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual fig 10; real pattern

parts.name: trigger_guard
parts.construction: Integral heavy polymer loop (no seam): bottom bar ~6-7 mm deep at Z -100, legs ~6 mm, edges R 1.5-2, large rectangular inside with R 6-8 corners.
parts.wear: bottom whitening, inside front polished by the finger
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual fig 10 #12 (integral with the grip housing)

parts.name: pistol_grip
parts.construction: Integral grip, rounded-oblong section ~31-33 mm wide (unseen; norm), front strap R 9-10, back strap R 12-14, beaver-tail web at the top rear, ~55-62 mm fore-aft, flared base lip ~3 mm; lower ~9 mm = separate grip cover with a 0.3 x 0.5 mm seam and a flat plain bottom (R 1 rim). Stipple panel both sides: rounded-rectangle inset from ~20 % below the top to ~12 % above the bottom, ~5 mm in from both straps; border = 0.5-0.6 mm geometric step with a 0.3 mm break; stipple in the normal map (pebbles 0.5-0.8 mm pitch, 0.1-0.15 mm tall).
key_features: rake 22 deg
the small mark near the bottom in the 3/4 = the cover seam
parts.wear: front/back strap and web polished; stipple crowns polished; base lip whitened
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual parts 33 + 58 (pistol grip cover)
parts.unseen_treatment: grip bottom = flat cover face, no hole

parts.name: selector
parts.construction: Ambidextrous teardrop levers on one transverse shaft: hub dia ~20 (sheet) on a seat boss 1.0 mm proud; blade tapering from ~12 mm at the hub tangent to ~6 mm at an R 3 tip, tip 21-24 mm from the axis; 2.5-3 mm plate, R 0.8 edge round, tip +0.5 mm thumb ledge; index line = 0.5 x 0.3 mm groove across the hub along the blade, unpainted; right lever same outline ~10 % smaller.
key_features: rest = sheet pose = SEMI: blade ~65 deg below the rearward horizontal
SAFE: blade forward-down (~45 deg below forward)
AUTO: ~45 deg further rearward than SEMI (near horizontal)
clips that move the bolt hold AUTO
no red dot, no pictograms
parts.wear: bright blade tip and hub rim; thumb-arc polish on the housing (right-handed: left side)
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.14-15 fig 11a-c (img62/65/68), parts 48-49
parts.confidence: medium (angles to confirm on the figures)

parts.name: trigger
parts.construction: Steel blade ~6 mm wide, curved forward-concave, smooth face crowned R 8 across, ~30 mm below the housing; pivots on a transverse axle (flush pin heads both sides).
key_features: pull ~12-15 deg about Y
parts.wear: bright face
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual part 34 + axles

parts.name: mag_release
parts.construction: One centred steel paddle (Y = 0) behind the magwell, ahead of the guard's front leg: ~10 mm wide, 3 mm thick, ~18 mm below the housing, forward-curved finger pad (R 4); pivot ~8 mm above the housing face inside the catch window; nose engages the magazine notch >= 1.5 mm; pushed FORWARD to release (rotate about Y ~10-12 deg).
parts.wear: bright pad face
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.19 ('push magazine catch forward'), fig 10 #2, parts 50-52; HKUMP45 photo

parts.name: bolt
parts.construction: Rectangular blowback block (~26 mm wide, fills the port height), longer upper section overhanging rearward with the spring-guide bore at the top front; bolt face with a 12 mm case-head boss and a 1.5 mm firing-pin hole; extractor claw (5x25 mm) inset in the right face at the bolt face, hook 1 mm over the face; THUMB RECESS on the right face: oval scallop ~16x9 mm, 1.5 mm deep, centred in the port at rest; guide grooves along both lower edges on the receiver rails (0.2 mm per side); charging lug on the top front.
key_features: rest: face at the barrel breech ~X 485
travel 75 mm (back to ~X 410)
0.4 mm M-chamfers, milling passes in roughness only
parts.wear: sliding polish on the flanks; soot at the face
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.12-13 (bolt group, 'right side of the bolt has a thumb recess'), img47-49, img118

parts.name: ejection_port_and_stock_catch
parts.construction: Right side only, X 453-515, Z -2..+22, through the wall, corners R 2, 45 deg deflector chamfer on the rear edge; the vertical tab at the port front (X 517-527, proud ~3 mm) is the integral stock catch with a hooked rear face (undercut 1.0-1.5 mm).
key_features: dark interior: bolt, breech, feed lips (class E)
parts.wear: polished catch lip; light soot at the port rear edge
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.11-12 ('the ejection port includes an integral catch'; 'buttstock engages on the catch located on the forward part of the ejection port'); img42

parts.name: barrel
parts.construction: Steel barrel 200 mm, breech ~X 485, pinned in the upper (transverse roll pin, unseen); visible OD 17.7 at the thread collar, steel collar ring OD ~26 (X 620-632) in a counterbore of the receiver face; bore dia 11.4, dark, >= 2 calibres deep; polygonal bore texture only.
parts.wear: edge brightening on the collar ring
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.11 (barrel inserted and pinned), part 16-17 (roll pin 6x32)

parts.name: muzzle_device
parts.construction: Slotted cage OD ~24, 39 mm long (X 651-690), open front; six through-slots at 60 deg, one centred on each side (3 visible in side views, 2 in TOP), ~4 mm wide x ~26 mm, round ends; bars 6-7 mm; front rim ring ~5 mm (0.6 mm outer chamfer, 1 mm bore chamfer); rear ring, 2 mm groove, then the jam nut / thread collar (X 632-651) with two 3 mm wrench flats on the underside only; bore ID ~13.5.
parts.wear: soot gradient from each slot and the crown; bright front rim
parts.real_pattern_evidence: HKUMP45 photo (slotted hider at the muzzle)

parts.name: top_rail
parts.construction: gunlib.rail_1913: 21.2 mm dovetail, 45 deg flanks, 5.24 mm square-bottomed slots at 10.01 mm pitch, 3.0 mm deep, 0.3-0.5 mm chamfers, on a ~30-34 mm wide x ~4 mm base flange (TOP band width); total height ~11.8 (sheet); X ~308-607 (~29 slots); two socket-head cap screws (head dia 8.5) counterbored in two slot floors, heads 0.3 mm below the floor; butt joint 0.01-0.05 mm.
key_features: slot count = round(length/10.01); the sheet's teeth are irregular
parts.wear: bright slot edges and flank crests; grime in slot roots
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.17 (rails screwed onto moulded-in hard points; 2 screws per rail, parts 64-67)

parts.name: lower_rail
parts.construction: Short 1913 rail under the forearm front, facing down, X ~540-611, 6 slots (sheet), same profile and base flange rule, 2 counterbored screws.
parts.wear: as the top rail
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.17

parts.name: front_flip_sight
parts.construction: Rail-clamp base with a recoil lug in one slot (integer index) and a transverse cross-bolt (head on the LEFT, captive jaw/nut on the right); leaf on a transverse pin with a spring detent (no button); two ears 2.5-3 mm thick (tops R 1) and a 1.85 mm square post between them, tip flat with a 0.2 mm break, level with the aperture centre; adjuster ring geometry only if >= 4 px at ADS. Folds REARWARD; folded <= rail top + 12 mm.
key_features: class A texels
parts.wear: bright ear tops
parts.real_pattern_evidence: generic rail-clamp backup sights (no equivalent on the real gun, whose front post + hood sit on the receiver)

parts.name: rear_flip_sight
parts.construction: Rail-clamp base as the front; rectangular leaf with two protective side ears framing a round aperture disc (10 mm boss, aperture dia 2.0 mm, 45 deg eye-side countersink); a plain round windage drum on the base's right side (knurl in the normal map, no ticks). Folds FORWARD; folded <= rail top + 12 mm.
key_features: Sight socket at the aperture centre
class A texels
parts.wear: bright ear edges
parts.real_pattern_evidence: generic rail-clamp diopter; the real gun's rear sight is a flip diopter with peep and U-notch on the receiver (manual p.11)

parts.name: stock_hinge_and_latch
parts.construction: Corner hinge at the RIGHT rear: vertical steel axle dia 6 through two receiver-side knuckles (top, bottom; steel bushings) and one stock-side centre knuckle. LEFT: the drawn vertical rounded boss = the stock's latch housing (spring latch bolt moving along Y into a notch in the receiver's left rear) with a vertical oval release button (~7 x 16 mm, 1 mm proud, 2 mm stroke) in its outer face; the drawn grooves = button outline and knuckle splits. Stock-side hinge block joggled (short Z-link) so the folded frame's inner face sits 2-4 mm off the highest right-side feature.
key_features: fold: rotate about +Z ~180 deg to the RIGHT
swept minimum >= 0.10 mm
folded retention: the port catch hook, engagement >= 1.0 mm
bounds extension over both states x every LOD
parts.wear: button face polished; knuckle edges whitened; grime in the knuckle splits
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.12 (folds right; press the catch; engages the port catch; axle, lock and spring parts 22, 25, 26); img29, img42, img43; Ump-side illustration

parts.name: stock_frame
parts.construction: One-piece moulded skeleton frame symmetric about its mid-plane (1 deg draft each way, parting witness around the middle); top strut Z +4.7..+16.5 (~29.5 wide), lower strut rising ~19 deg from the hinge block to the toe (~12 mm deep), slanted web X ~121-138 splitting a small front triangle from a large rear opening, rear upright X 28-42; raised 0.8-1.0 mm border step 1.5 mm in from each opening edge, R 1.5 inner rounds; solid struts with flat faces; two dia ~6 through-holes on the rear upright (lower = SlingRear); dia 4 locking-pin storage hole in the front strut.
key_features: no cheek piece (the real one has a rubber cheek piece; not drawn)
folded it lies along the right side; see C-Q3 on the port
parts.wear: cheek-weld polish on the top strut (left), whitening on outer corners and the toe
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.12 (open frame, rubber pad, locking-pin hole); img24, img30; Ump-side illustration (toe hole)

parts.name: butt_pad
parts.construction: Rubber pad X 0-28, height 107, width ~55-59 (TOP), wrapping the upright with a 2 mm lip; horizontal ribs on the rear face as geometry (count from the trace, ~12-14, pitch ~7-8, depth ~1.2, R 0.6 crests); edges R 3-4; 0.3 mm seam to the frame.
parts.wear: dust in the rib roots; toe/heel scuffs
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.12 (rubber pad), img42

parts.name: magazine
parts.construction: Straight solid polymer double-stack housing tapering to a single-feed top over ~30 mm; section 42 fore-aft x ~27 thick (confirm in blockout), corners R 3 front / R 2.5 rear; inside 0.25 deg core draft only; two parallel recessed channels per side (each ~4.5 wide, 1.0 deep, 3.5 apart) from ~25 mm below the top to ~15 mm above the floor plate, crossed by flush ties (4 levels on LEFT); front spine rib ~6 wide, 0.8 proud, parting line on its crest; rear spine plain with the catch notch (window ~8x4, 2.5 deep, square bearing face, ~30 mm below the top); feed lips folded inward (wall 2.0), front top stepped higher; dark follower visible, no cartridge.
key_features: raked ~8 deg (bottom forward); straight insertion along its own axis
0.3 mm per side in the well; overtravel 1-2 mm
mass empty 0.17 kg (manual)
parts.wear: insertion streaks on the upper 40 mm; polished spine crest and lips; whitened floor-plate corners; dust in the ladder floors
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.16 + p.27 (housing, floor plate, follower, spring, locking plate; floor plate slides off to the rear, held by the locking plate tab); img73, img74, img86, img87

parts.name: magazine_floor_plate
parts.construction: Separate cap 5 mm thick, lip 1.5-2.0 mm proud all round, front edge R 4; slides onto rails moulded into the housing's bottom flange from the rear; bottom face carries a dia 8 hole with the locking plate's dark tab flush inside and fine slide-rail seams.
parts.wear: corner whitening (drops), Base impact zone
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.27, img73 part 2
parts.unseen_treatment: bottom face: locking-tab hole + seams (real pattern; not on the sheet)

parts.name: sling_points
parts.construction: Front: eyelet hole dia 6-7 through a solid boss at the receiver's front-left corner below the rail base, steel sleeve 0.6 mm proud (SlingFront). Rear: the stock's lower rear through-hole (SlingRear).
parts.wear: sleeve rim bright
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.11 (left-side eyebolts), p.41 (attached to receiver, handstop or buttstock)

parts.name: pins_and_fasteners
parts.construction: Flush steel inset rings: front support bolt head (magwell front top), rear locking pin head (dia 7, end block left), trigger/hammer/selector axles; dia 4-7, 0.3 mm chamfer, 0.1-0.2 mm proud or sunk as each sheet head reads; count and position from the trace only.
parts.wear: rims brightened, grime around
parts.real_pattern_evidence: manual p.14 (front lugs on support bolts, rear removable locking pin), parts 23, 36

polymer_black.micro_texture: moulded matte (EDM-spark class, Ra ~2-3 um) as Detail16 normal noise, feature 0.05-0.15 mm, tile ~20 mm

grip_stipple.texture: pebbles 0.5-0.8 mm pitch, 0.1-0.15 mm tall (normal + AO)

sheet_samples_srgb_median.note: lit values; polymer/backdrop 0.40, steel 0.26-0.32, mag 0.36; neutral with B-R +2..+3; calibrate under matched light (study 3.3)

wear_logic: polymer never shows metal: polish (G) where hands slide, whitening (R) where struck or abraded
polish: grip straps and web, forearm belly + left side, magwell flare, top strut cheek zone, selector arc
whitening: receiver corners, front-face rim, forearm lower edge, vent/port lips, magwell lip, stock outer corners, pad toe/heel, floor plate
insertion: scratch fan into the magwell mouth; streaks on the mag's upper 40 mm
steel bright edges: rail slot edges and flank crests, sight ears, device rim and slots, knob crown, selector tip, trigger face; sliding polish on bolt flanks and channel lips
cavity grime (B): rail slot roots, vent ends, ladder channels, pin surrounds, pad rib roots, hinge splits, stipple roots
soot: device slots and crown; light at the port rear edge
right-handed: more support-hand polish on the left; port soot and selector thumb arc on the right; left/right differ

both drawn slots are moulded through-vents, as drawn per side
rulings.evidence: sheet LEFT/RIGHT/3/4; the real right side has no slot, the real left slot is the lever channel behind the lever
rulings.plan: overrides R18 default; user check C-Q1

rulings.ruling: rectangular block, extractor right, thumb recess on the right face visible in the port; travel 75 mm; rest face at ~X 485
right only; the drawn front tab = integral stock catch with a hooked rear face

not built (no bone); ReloadEmpty releases the held-open bolt with the charging lever

rulings.ruling: solid; recessed ladder channels; front spine rib with the parting line; floor plate on rear-entry rails with a locking-tab hole; single-feed lips; follower, no cartridge; thickness ~27 to confirm
steel C-fillet blade, crowned smooth face
integral polymer loop at the sheet's thickness, no seam
integral; stipple border geometry + stipple normal; bottom ~9 mm = separate cover with a seam
21.2 dovetail on a ~30-34 mm base flange (TOP width); pitch 10.01; 2 counterbored screws per rail in slot floors
rail-clamp base + recoil lug + cross-bolt head on the left; spring detent, no button; rear folds forward, front folds rearward; aperture 2.0 in a 10 mm disc; post 1.85; folded <= rail + 12

rulings.ruling: 6 slots at 60 deg, one centred per side; open front; jam nut with underside flats
rulings.evidence: sheet LEFT/TOP slot counts; HKUMP45 photo

rulings.ruling: SlingFront = front-left eyelet hole; SlingRear = the stock's lower rear hole
steel flush heads where drawn (front support bolt, rear locking pin); stock front hole = locking-pin storage (dia 4)
0.3-0.5 mm design seam, 0.6 deep, along the drawn line
the lower's integrated backplate; seam at its front edge
flare 1.5-2 mm per side, 1 deg draft, catch window, top shelf, NO guide ribs
rulings.evidence: the mag's ladder is recessed; manual fig 10

open_questions.q: Charging handle: keep the knob where drawn with a real 75 mm channel behind it and the drawn slots as vents, or move the knob ~35 mm forward to the slot's front (costs TOP/3/4 silhouette)?

Folded stock crosses the port on the sheet's proportions: accept as drawn (folded = carry/no-fire) or raise the top strut (changes the side silhouette)?
